title: Constraint-like equations helped hide complexity from traditional science

fields.label: Label
fields.value: Constraint-like equations helped hide complexity from traditional science

fields.label: Statement
fields.value: Because describing complex behavior with constraints requires fairly complicated constraints, the traditional focus of science and mathematics on equations that act like constraints is another reason they failed to identify the phenomenon of complexity.

fields.label: Quotation
fields.value: the fact that traditional science and mathematics tends to concentrate on equations that operate like constraints provides yet another reason for their failure to identify the fundamental phenomenon of complexity that I discuss in this book.

fields.label: Agent
fields.value: delphisci A New Kind of Science claim extractor

fields.label: Assumptions
fields.value: Stephen Wolfram, A New Kind of Science (Champaign, IL: Wolfram Media, 2002), Chapter 5, “Two Dimensions and Beyond”; section “Systems Based on Constraints” (from p. 210), p. 221. Scope: methods of traditional science and mathematics

fields.label: Assessment
fields.value: GPT-5.6 Sol on wolfram2002-ch05-22: not-empirically-resolvable, resolvability 0.17

fields.label: Finding
fields.value: This is a historical and rhetorical causal interpretation with no discriminating decision criterion. Bibliometric proxies would substantially change the claim and leave major confounding.

fields.label: Proposed test in the assessment
fields.value: Proposed test with existing data: One could count equation-based and rule-based publications over time, but no observable counterfactual establishes that methodological emphasis caused science to miss a vaguely defined phenomenon.

fields.label: Evidence against
fields.value:
“Fundamental phenomenon of complexity” has no fixed indicator.

The causal counterfactual is not identifiable.

Traditional science and mathematics are unbounded populations.

fields.label: Dimension scores
fields.value:
data adequacy: 0.15
data existence: 0.25
discriminating power: 0.1
analysis feasibility: 0.25
operationalizability: 0.12

fields.label: Finding
fields.value: Whether equations-as-constraints delayed the recognition of complexity is a counterfactual about the history of science. Publication archives record what was studied; they do not record which alternative methods would have found the phenomenon. No outcome distinguishes this reason from other accounts of the same history.

fields.label: Proposed test in the assessment
fields.value: Proposed test with existing data: The sentence names a historical cause of a disciplinary failure. No variable in the scientific record is the counterfactual complexity research that would have occurred under a different choice of equations.

fields.label: Evidence against
fields.value:
The sentence is a causal claim about the history of method.

The same publication record fits many other accounts of when complexity became a topic.
